thread:
Lia (AE): Riverbank wants a focused POC to move from CompetitorX -> Redwood. Key asks: prompt parity, response diffs, cost per-1k messages, and security questionnaire. Can eng/security split tasks?
Omar (ML Eng): I can run diffs. Need a 48h redacted prompt dump and their typical sequence lengths. Also confirm if streaming realtime token hooks are used.
Lia (AE): They use streaming; peak concurrencies ~500. I'll ask for the dump and sample traffic histogram.
Rina (Solutions Eng): POC plan suggestion: 1) lightweight proxy to accept CompetitorX payloads -> Redwood, 2) replay traffic at controlled QPS on sandbox, 3) run golden prompt suite and produce diff report. I can ship the proxy.
Rina (Solutions Eng): proxy snippet: POST /proxy -> map body.text -> {"input": body.text, "model":"redwood-medium", "temperature":0}
Omar (ML Eng): For parity runs use temperature=0 and top_p=0.0 to reduce sampling variance. Capture tokenizer outputs; CompetitorX uses different tokenization heuristics.
Cal (Product): For pricing delta I need median and p95 sequence lengths and percent streaming vs non-streaming. I'll produce hosted vs dedicated cost scenarios and show batching impact.
Tess (Security): I'll take the SQ. Need answers for retention, SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS/BYOK, and egress allowlist. If they require customer-managed keys, Private covers that.
replay-bot: replay job queued by Rina - job_id=12021 - ETA 14m.
Rina (Solutions Eng): Timeline (8 business days): Day 1-2 adapter + infra, Day 3 replay capture, Day 4-5 parity analysis, Day 6 prompt fixes + retest, Day 7 pricing & SQ draft, Day 8 joint review.
Omar (ML Eng): Add to comparator: strip IDs/dates, canonicalize whitespace, apply competitor postprocessing rules, then diff token-levenshtein and embedding cosine.
Lia (AE): I'll get the sample and the security questionnaire uploaded to the shared drive. Linking legal once SQ draft done.
Cal (Product): Note: we may need to surface that exact seed-based determinism (CompetitorX's seed param) isn't publicly supported; we can run internal seeded experiments for the POC. Call that out in the runbook.
Tess (Security): Also flag SLA/legal blocker: if they require custom audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, we need to confirm retention and delivery method.
Lia (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank uploads sample + SQ, 2) Rina to deploy proxy + start replay, 3) Tess to draft SQ answers, 4) Cal+Omar run parity and cost model. Sync in 6 business days. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Omar (ML Eng): ack
Rina (Solutions Eng): ack
Cal (Product): ack
Tess (Security): ack
Lia (AE): thanks - will share calendar invite.
